scope: Four Pune central and four already inspected Chennai development/regression crops, not a blind test or full-scene accuracy estimate.
decision: Shortest supported repair that improves road IoU, precision and recall in both locations. Reject aggressive gap filling and indiscriminate singleton deletion.
tradeoff: Pune overall accuracy 89.7624% to 89.7275%; Chennai 77.9680% to 77.9140%. Chennai mean IoU drops 0.0376 percentage point. Road improvement is small, not reliable highway extraction.
